result.summary: Found minor visual and content issues including a font rendering/typographic error in a restaurant name and a cut-off card at the bottom.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Rameı' uses a dotless 'ı' instead of 'n' at the end.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling of the restaurant name to 'Tokumaru Ramen'.
